newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metro Pacific eyes new real estate project.
newsitem.headline: Metro Pacific eyes new real estate project.

text.p: Philippine conglomerate Metro Pacific Corp said on Friday it is planning to participate in the bidding of the 51 percent stake in Manila's Food Terminal Inc.
"We are considering that project at this point," Metro Pacific president Napoleon Nazareno told reporters after the stockholders' meeting.
Food Terminal Inc operates a 121-hectare agro-industrial complex located at the outskirts of the financial district of Makati.
Nazareno said Metro Pacific would attend the pre-bidding conference the government will conduct early next month to explore the investment opportunity.
"At this point, it is purely exploratory on our part," Nazareno said.
Metro Pacific went into real estate development two years ago after it successfully bid for the right to develop a 214-hectare tract of land at the edge of Makati.
